shots.what_happens: Narration words w0-w10 are mirrored as on-screen text: 'Building AI agents that can speak' reveals word by word left to right with a blurred, glowing leading edge, then is replaced by 'is now easier than ever.', which reveals the same way and then scales up slightly as the shot ends.

shots.focal_element: Stylised, recreated agent-builder UI cards on a near-white background, alternating with a large animated gradient orb that represents the agent's voice
on_screen_text: You are a sophisticated yet practical weekend planning assistant. You suggest activities, restaurants, and entertainment based on their interests, budget, and schedule. Your suggestions always include...
Hey, welcome to QuickCrate. How can I help you today?
Hey, can I check the status of my order?
Yes, of course. Let me check for you now.
Your order is due to arrive at around 2pm.
Hello and welcome DHK online, how can I help you today?
Select which provider and model to use for the LLM.
Upload a file that will be passed to the LLM alongside the prompt.
Drop the file to upload it
Supported types: pdf, txt, docx, html, epub.
The system prompt is used to determine the persona of the agent and the context of the conversation.

You are a customer support / bookings agent for BoundEvents names Eric. You are friendly and enthusiastic and your goal is to help the customer get the help they need. Answer with short answers in 1-2 sentences and keep it the tone light and formal.
shots.typography: Two registers. Product UI: small, regular/medium-weight neutral sans-serif (Inter-like, low-confidence guess), sentence case, normal tracking, dark grey on light cards; voice names in the picker are uppercase with slightly open tracking, inactive names faded. Display: 'Conversational AI' as a large medium-bold sans with a gradient fill and glow, and 'Build, test, and deploy.' as a heavy, tightly leaded left-aligned stack, one word per line, revealed word by word in sync with narration. The model list in the LLM dropdown is shown enlarged with fading inactive items. The hex values in the Avatar colour fields are deliberately not quoted (colours come from code); the tiny card descriptions and avatar name labels on the opening template grid were too small to read verbatim.
shots.what_happens: One long continuous shot (3.1-51.7 s, 17 events) with in-shot reframes and no hard cuts. A cursor clicks the 'Support agent' template in a 'Create an AI agent' grid; the UI dissolves into a large swirling gradient orb that speaks the greeting (w11-w19), shrinks and resolves into the 'Conversational AI' + ElevenLabs lockup (w20-w24). The 'Build, test, and deploy.' stack builds word by word on the left (w25-w28) while a QuickCrate agent config panel scrolls on the right with cursor-driven fields: system prompt and first message type on, LLM set to Claude 3.5 Sonnet, voice picked from a dropdown, avatar colours filled. The panel gives way to a chat transcript where user and agent bubbles stream in with the dialogue (w42-w68), plus an 'Order arriving at 2pm' tool chip and a 'Call Status / Success' row. A single 'Transcription' tile then expands into a dashed-line pipeline of tiles (Transcription, Turn taking, LLM, Knowledge base, Text-to-Speech, Testing, branching to Phone and Website) while narration says it used to be complex (w69-w81); on 'but not anymore' (w82-w84) the tiles scatter and get swallowed by the orb. A 'Voice Design' card types its prompt and preview text (w85-w99), the orb returns with a vertical voice-name picker that scrolls and recolours the orb per voice (Amelia, Otto, Raju, Sully, Jessica), the orb then speaks as a 'Talk to interrupt' call widget (w108-w119), and finally, with the orb parked at the left edge, cards for LLM model selection (scrolling dropdown), knowledge-base file upload (drag-and-drop file icon) and a system prompt that types on (w120-w146) follow, ending on a blur-out of the system prompt card.
shots.build_rebuild: Build a single 48 s composition on an off-white background with one persistent gradient-orb component (conic gradient + blur + slow rotation, recoloured per voice) and a stack of recreated UI cards that enter with blur/scale dissolves and are driven by a scripted cursor, typing each text field character by character and streaming chat bubbles timed to the dialogue word indices (w11-w146), with the left-column kinetic 'Build, test, and deploy.' stack revealed per word at w25-w28.
